new-7-30-2.quote: Answer Correctness = 0.25 × 语义相似度 + 0.75 × 事实准确度。事实准确度（F1）：TP / (TP + 0.5 × (FP + FN))

per_option.label: A
per_option.why: 语义相似度仅占0.25权重，非主因

per_option.label: B
per_option.why: 事实F1占0.75权重且用户反馈事实错误，最可能偏低

per_option.label: C
per_option.why: Context Precision属检索端指标，与Correctness无关

per_option.label: D
per_option.why: Faithfulness需contexts字段，题干未提其异常
